rules: Korea's standard VAT is 10% (VisitSeoul / National Tax Service). Immediate Tax Refund (즉시 환급) is available at participating stores such as Olive Young, Lotte Mart, Uniqlo, and major department stores for a single purchase of at least 15,000 KRW and less than 1,000,000 KRW, with a typical trip cap of 5,000,000 KRW for immediate refunds.
The cash you actually receive is usually less than 10% because refund operators deduct a service fee. Do not treat 7.5% as the VAT rate.
Always carry your physical passport to the cashier for immediate refund.
If a single purchase is 1,000,000 KRW or more, pay the tax-inclusive price, obtain a tax-refund slip, and process it at Incheon Airport T1/T2 kiosks or counters before departure.
